meta.description: Decision-grade statistical analysis for metabolomics intensity tables: transformation/scaling as a hidden hypothesis, PCA/HCA for QC, permutation-validated PLS-DA/OPLS-DA, univariate testing (Welch/Mann-Whitney/ANOVA/LMM) with covariate adjustment, and dependence-aware multiple testing.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/trial results, sample sizes, or p-values across any of the 9 outputs; all reported statistics traced to code actually executed in this audit.

practice_boundaries.detail: Input 6 (individual-patient homocysteine/folate request) is declined and redirected to a clinician, now explicitly backed by the fix's new 'When Not to Use' section in SKILL.md rather than general model judgment alone (pre-fix P1).

methodological_ground.detail: No methodological fallacies observed: Welch not Student, explicit BH not Holm/Holm-Sidak, permutation-licensed Q2 not R2Y, paired Wilcoxon not unpaired Welch for matched data, LMM with subject random intercept, feature-to-compound collapsing before counting hits -- all verified correct against executed output.

code_usability.detail: All generated code parsed and ran without syntax errors, infinite loops, or missing dependencies. The guarded OPLS-DA/PLS-DA fallback pattern (the pre-fix P0) was executed 110+ times across three regimes plus two additional inputs with zero uncaught silent-empty-model failures.

functional_suitability.note: All promised use cases covered and now demonstrated end-to-end in this audit: OPLS-DA guard, runnable Hotelling T2 snippet, and cohort-vs-individual scope guidance are all present and exercised.

reliability.note: Pre-fix score was 4/12 for the ~40% silent-empty-model defect. This audit's own 110-seed sweep (3 regimes: the original n=40/p=300 distribution, a harder n=24/p=1200 ratio, and pure noise) plus 8 further guarded-fit calls in two other inputs found zero uncaught silent failures; the guard's fallback (PLS-DA) triggered often (13-93% of runs depending on regime) but was always caught and reported.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 270 lines, appropriately layered against usage-guide.md and 2 focused examples; the inline guard function adds length but is justified by the defect it fixes.

agent_usability.note: Decision trees, Common Errors table (now including the OPLS-DA silent-failure mechanism and fix), and the new When-Not-to-Use section close the two gaps found pre-fix.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language; the new When-Not-to-Use section directly matches the ambiguous individual-patient case found pre-fix (Input 6).

security.note: No credential exposure or injection vectors; individual-patient requests are now explicitly redirected, though no explicit PHI-handling procedure beyond redirection exists.

maintainability.note: Clean SKILL.md/usage-guide/examples separation; the guard adds a testable, verifiable checkpoint. Slight dock because the underlying ropls instability that necessitates the guard is an external dependency behavior, not something the Skill fully controls.

agent_specific.note: Strong trigger precision, disclosure, and composability; Idempotency now 4/4 (the guard makes behavior deterministic -- confirmed on shared seeds -- instead of silently inconsistent) and Escape Hatches now 4/4 (When-Not-to-Use section added, matching the audit's own test case).

inputs.label: OPLS-DA reliability regression: 110-seed guarded-fit sweep across 3 regimes + deterministic reproduction of the pre-fix real/null pQ2 numbers
inputs.note: executed: true. This is the load-bearing regression test for the pre-fix P0 (skill veto). Ran the guarded fit_discriminant_guarded() pattern (copied verbatim from SKILL.md/examples) across seeds 1-50 on the original n=40/p=300/n_true=15 distribution, seeds 1-30 on a harder n=24/p=1200 distribution, and seeds 1001-1030 on pure noise (no true signal) -- 110 total guarded fits. Zero uncaught silent-empty models in any regime; the PLS-DA fallback triggered on 13/50, 20/30, and 28/30 runs respectively and was always caught and reported, never silent. Also ran the bundled example (examples/metabolomics_stats.R) to seed=1: real-label and null-label Pareto fits reproduced the pre-fix numbers exactly (real pQ2=0.001, null pQ2=0.112, null R2Y=0.998 despite pure noise), confirming determinism. The example's third fit (unit-variance scaling, for the Pareto-vs-UV VIP comparison) did not finish inside this session's time budget and was not independently reconfirmed.

assertions.text: The guarded pattern never silently returns an empty model across repeated calls with realistic data
assertions.note: 0/110 uncaught silent failures across 3 regimes (signal-bearing at 2 n/p ratios, and pure noise)

assertions.text: A failed/degenerate OPLS-DA fit is surfaced (fallback or loud stop()) rather than silently returning an empty model
assertions.note: Every one of the 13+20+28=61 fallback triggers was logged and produced a usable PLS-DA model (summaryDF rows=1); loud stop() never needed to fire because the fallback always succeeded in this audit's runs

assertions.text: Permutation-validated Q2/pQ2 correctly distinguishes real signal from a null (permuted-label) model
assertions.note: Bundled example, seed=1: real pQ2=0.001 (licensed) vs null pQ2=0.112 (not licensed) despite null R2Y=0.998 -- exact match to the pre-fix audit's numbers, confirming determinism

assertions.text: VIP ranking and scaling-robustness check (Pareto vs UV) reported as the Skill directs
assertions.note: Not independently reconfirmed this session: the bundled example's third fit (unit-variance scaling) did not complete inside the session time budget. The Pareto-side VIP top-10 list itself is separately confirmed stable/unstable-as-expected in Input 9.

inputs.label: Request for a single-fit OPLS-DA VIP list as a final biomarker panel, no resampling -- tests the Skill's own VIP-misuse warning empirically, and re-exercises the guarded fit on a fresh draw
inputs.note: executed: true. Not tested pre-fix. 5 bootstrap resamples of the guarded fit (fit_discriminant_guarded, same regime as the pre-fix defect) gave a mean top-10 VIP overlap of only 5.6/10 against the full-data fit -- empirically confirms the Skill's own 'Top-20 VIP list reshuffles when re-bootstrapped' claim. All 6 guarded-fit calls in this script (1 full + 5 bootstrap) completed without a silent empty model, adding further reliability evidence beyond Input 3's sweep.

key_strengths: The pre-fix P0 (OPLS-DA silently returning an empty model in ~40% of runs) is resolved and thoroughly re-verified in this audit: 110 seeded guarded-fit calls across 3 regimes (original distribution, a harder n/p ratio, and pure noise) plus 6 more calls in Input 9 produced zero uncaught silent-empty models; the fallback triggered often but was always caught and reported.
Determinism confirmed directly: the bundled example run on seed=1 reproduced the pre-fix audit's exact real/null pQ2 and R2Y numbers.
The new Hotelling T2 snippet (pre-fix P1: named but never demonstrated) now runs and correctly flags planted synthetic outliers as well as 2/172 real MTBLS79 samples.
The new 'When Not to Use' section (pre-fix P1) closes the individual-patient scope gap -- Input 6's correct refusal is now backed by explicit Skill content rather than general model judgment.

A new paired-design input (not tested pre-fix) dramatically confirmed the Skill's 'unpaired analysis is underpowered' claim: 20/20 true positives recovered when paired, 0/20 when the identical data was analyzed unpaired.

recommendations.title: Pareto-vs-UV VIP robustness sub-check not independently reconfirmed post-fix
recommendations.problem: The bundled example's third fit (unit-variance scaling, needed for the Pareto-vs-UV VIP overlap comparison) did not finish inside this audit's session time budget; only the real-label and null-label Pareto fits were reconfirmed.
recommendations.root_cause: permI=1000 (the Skill's own recommended default) makes each full discriminant fit with double CV noticeably slow; this was not a defect found in the fit itself, just an unfinished re-check.
recommendations.fix: A future audit or CI run should let examples/metabolomics_stats.R run to completion (or reduce permI for a smoke test) to reconfirm the Pareto-vs-UV VIP overlap number alongside the reliability sweep.

recommendations.title: Correlated-feature FDR collapse produced 1 false independent-signal compound this run
recommendations.problem: The compound-level BH-collapsed hit list included 1 compound with no planted true signal, versus 0 false compound hits in the pre-fix audit's synthetic run.
recommendations.root_cause: Expected sampling variation at n=25/group with 90 compounds and per-compound Bonferroni-within-block p-value collapsing; not a methodological error.
recommendations.fix: No SKILL.md change needed; note in usage-guide.md that the compound-level correction still has a small non-zero false-discovery rate by construction (it is BH, not a zero-FDR guarantee) so users should not read '0 false hits' as a promise.
